verdict.rationale: GitLab runs a first-party technology-partners directory listing many third-party integrations (Cursor, Greptile, Make, monday.com, Notion, Semgrep, PagerDuty, Slack, and others). Its AI Catalog also lets users discover and share agents and flows created by GitLab and community members. However, the directory reads as a partner listing, not an in-product marketplace with documented install flows, and the only one-click install mention covers cluster apps like Helm and Prometheus. Missing for 10: a documented in-product install/enable flow from the directory, evidence that third-party integrations (not just agents/flows) are installable from a catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration.
